Definition: from G2753; a cry of incitement:--shout.
BiblicalUsage: Keleuma means a shout, a cry of command. 1 Thessalonians 4:16 says the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Lord's return will not be quiet: a shout, a voice, and a trumpet will wake the dead in Christ first.
